description: This file defines the ChannelPostsApiController class, which handles API requests related to post sorting within channels. It includes methods for validating node stories and updating their order through HTTP PUT requests.

classes.name: ChannelPostsApiController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for API endpoints managing channel post operations, such as sorting, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: validateNodeStory
methods.description: Validates that the current user has permission to access a specific node post, throwing exceptions if access is denied or the post is not found.

methods.name: channelpostsSortAction
methods.description: Handles sorting updates for a node post within a channel; processes PUT requests to reorder a post and returns JSON response with the resulting order status.
